[SWS_CRYPT_03008]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The interfaces
ara::crypto::cryp::KeyEn-
capsulatorPublicCtx::GetEncapsulatedSize
and
ara::crypto::cryp::
KeyDecapsulatorPrivateCtx::GetEncapsulatedSize
shall return the size of
the encapsulated keying-data in Bytes. The interfaces shall return 0, if the size is
unknown at this time, because
•
the configured KEM algorithm does not specify a fixed size.
•
the keying-data has not been set yet (encapsulation).
•
the encapsulated data has not been provided yet (decapsulation).
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02209)
